description: Peeling back the carpet reveals a map of every pet accident since 2009.
option_1: Lay the new carpet right over it
option_2: Clean and seal the stains with primer

description: Your foot sinks a little near the bathroom door. That's not supposed to happen.
option_1: Replace the subfloor in the whole house
option_2: Screw a sheet of plywood on top
option_3: Cut out and replace that section

description: Under the bad subfloor, a joist has a crack running halfway through it.
option_3: Replace every joist in the floor

description: With the carpet up, every step sounds like a haunted house.
option_1: Screw the subfloor down to the joists
option_2: Tear out and rebuild the floor
option_3: Sprinkle baby powder in the seams

description: Under the carpet: 9-inch tiles from the 1960s. Those might contain asbestos.
option_2: Test it and cover it with new flooring
option_3: Chip it up with a hammer

description: The new carpet is plush. Too plush. The doors won't close.
option_3: Trim the bottoms of the doors

description: Pulling the tack strip cracked two baseboards. They cracked louder than your knees.
option_2: Replace all baseboards and repaint the walls

description: The subfloor is bare. A tiny voice whispers: hardwood would look amazing.
option_1: Paint the subfloor and call it rustic
option_2: Switch to hardwood in the whole house

description: Your partner: "The room is empty anyway. Can you finally mount the TV?"
option_1: Hang it with plain drywall anchors
option_2: Mount it after the carpet is in
option_3: Build a full media wall with hidden wiring

description: You sealed the stains, but on hot days the room still smells like 2009.
option_1: Treat with enzyme cleaner and reseal
option_2: Spray air freshener under the pad
option_3: Replace the subfloor in the whole room

description: The new plywood is thicker than the old. There's a hump you can trip on.
option_2: Replace the whole room's subfloor to match

description: A drain pipe runs right where the new sister joist needs to go.
option_2: Use a shorter sister and add blocking
option_3: Cut the pipe to make room

description: Pssssst. You just screwed the subfloor down into a water line.
option_2: Shut off the water and splice the pipe
option_3: Leave the screw in to plug the hole

description: Under the old tile: thick black glue. That adhesive may contain asbestos too.
option_1: Leave it in place and cover it with underlayment
option_3: Strip it with a heat gun

description: You trim the door bottom and find... cardboard. It's a hollow-core door.
option_1: Leave it open at the bottom
option_3: Glue a wood strip back into the bottom

description: The new baseboards are shorter than the old ones. There's a stripe of unpainted wall.
option_1: Repaint every wall in the room
option_2: Touch up the wall above the baseboard

description: The new carpet is gorgeous. The stairs now look like a hiking trail.
option_1: Carpet the stairs and the upstairs hall too
option_2: Flip the stair runner upside down
option_3: Add the stairs to the next project

description: Your partner: "Before the couch goes back, what if we tried it by the window?"
option_1: Drag the couch across the fresh carpet
option_2: Buy all new furniture for the new layout
option_3: Try it once the carpet is down
